ideas.title: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the allegations of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the proposed overhaul of the state's Medicaid system
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How will the proposed overhaul of the Medicaid system prevent future abuse?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale pattern of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, and the proposed overhaul of the Medicaid system could be a key factor in preventing future abuse. I recommend investigating the allegations and tracking the progress of the overhaul.
